subject: Emotions
title: Mindfulness and Emotions
description: A short lesson to help you apply Mindfulness and Emotions.

hook.text: A meditator feels rage rising. Instead of reacting, she notes: 'There's anger. Hot. In my chest.' The wave passes.

buildup.text: Jon Kabat-Zinn introduced mindfulness to medicine in 1979. It trains the ability to observe emotions without reacting.

discovery.text: Eight weeks of mindfulness training shrinks the amygdala and thickens the prefrontal cortex measurably.

twist.text: Mindfulness doesn't eliminate negative emotions. It creates space between the emotion and your response to it.

climax.text: Meta-analyses show mindfulness reduces anxiety, depression, and stress comparably to medication—without side effects.

punchline.text: You are not your anger. You are the one noticing the anger.

quiz.question: What brain change occurs after 8 weeks of mindfulness?
